reading_card.problem: We investigate how CO2 injection changes the phase behaviour of gas hydrate-bearing marine sediment.
reading_card.data: Samples of 25 g wet sediment were collected from 3 gravity cores.
reading_card.method: Experiments were performed in a high-pressure cell at 12 MPa and 4 °C, using a CO2 fraction of 0.3 to 0.9.
reading_card.findings: CO2 injection increased the hydrate dissociation temperature by 2.4 °C at a CO2 fraction of 0.7.
reading_card.limitations: A limitation of this study is that only 3 cores were tested, so spatial variability cannot be assessed.
reading_card.premises: We assume a constant pore pressure of 12 MPa during each run.
